name: SuiteUI sources
description: The shared design system (Sources/SuiteUI, linking SuiteModel for SuiteApp): spacing, radius, size, type and color tokens; Liquid Glass applied in one snapshot-aware place (Glass) and GlassPanel; the SuiteWindow shell (sidebar, content, inspector) with SidebarSection and SidebarRow; ToolbarGroup palette actions; the content layer (CanvasSurface, SurfaceCard, EmptyStateView, ViewerStatusBar, BusyNote for open, save and import progress, and TransportCapsule, the shared transport over TransportStepping); the editor shell after the Ripple editor (EditorShell, EditorTopBar and its bar items, the docked ToolbarGroup rail, CanvasViewport with its Ruler, optional checkerboard, ZoomMath clamped zoom and fit with SuiteCanvasNavigating, the live CanvasNavigating over it, and CanvasMarks, SegmentedTabs and the ColorWell hex row); pro inspector parts (InspectorHeader, InspectorRows, ScrubField and NumericInput number entry); the Studio easing parts (CurveEditor, StudioScrubRow, ChoiceChips); AppMark, the one view that draws an app's mark (icon, glyph or line style) from AppMarkArt, path data scripts/render-marks generates from Bundle/Marks; ThumbnailGrid with its selection math; and TimelineStrip with its frame mapping, shared by Flare and Halo, with TimelineLaneLayers, the rules of its AppKit lanes renderer (which lanes redraw from an Equatable diff, a layer frame per lane, a press routed to the lane classification).
